newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania 91-day T-bill issue fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romania 91-day T-bill issue fully subscribed.

text.p: An offer of 82.050 billion lei of Romanian three-month treasury bills has been fully susbscribed, latest central bank data showed on Friday.
The bills, offering an annual rate of 49.31 percent, were bought by nine banks on Thursday and mature next February 27.

The Finance Ministry has launched several issues of 91-day T-bill issues in recent months to narrow a swollen state budget deficit. According to latest statistics, the state budget posted a 10-month gap of 2.86 trillion lei. That deficit is expected to widen to 4.2 trillion lei by year's end. ($=3,591 lei) -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
